description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Trey], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single attack (11.00 each) capped at 199,999, ranged. Grants [Fire, Ice, Water Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Fire, Ice, Water 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Critical Damage +50% (15s)], [Physical Instant Cast 2] or [Tactical Chase Mode: Trey] to all allies.

description.name: Fire, Ice, Water Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Fire, Ice, or Water attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Fire, Ice, Water 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [125% ATB 1] after using a Fire, Ice, or Water ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 125% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.25

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Critical Damage +50% (15s)
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Physical Instant Cast 2
description.text: Instant cast speed for PHY attacks

description.name: Tactical Chase Mode: Trey
description.text: Triggers [Battle Strike: Trey] when using Fire, Ice, or Water abilities (max 5), removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode
description.text: Keeps track of TP level (0~6), increases TP level by 1 when the character is hit by a damaging attack or an ally uses a damaging action, casts a certain ability when TP level reaches 6. Removed after 8 abilities.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode: Trey
description.text: Fire/Ice/Water abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [ATB_10%] after using Fire/Ice/Water abilities while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]
